Case M10: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 250x250x200 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M10 is complete. 

**Summary:** The myxoid soft-tissue tumor was a large, well-circumscribed T2-hyperintense lobulated mass in the limb. A single positive point prompt inside the bright core (axial slice 127) produced a clean single-component mask that followed the lesion boundary across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes (96.1 mL, one component). Checks at the mask ends (k = 93–173, j = 101–150, i = 117–174) showed the outline conforming to the bright mass with only a small tapered pole superiority and no missed satellite tissue (seg_candidates returned none). Final mask saved with medium confidence.
